title: HR Automation Specialist
jobDescription:
Location: Hybrid Pune

This role goes beyond traditional HR operations — it is focused on designing, building, and scaling automated HR workflows using tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, and AI-driven solutions. You will be responsible for transforming manual HR operations into intelligent, automated, and data-driven systems.

You will work at the intersection of HR, technology, and process engineering, driving end-to-end workflow automation, system integrations, and data governance across global HR operations.

  • This position operates in the EMEA/APAC shift to align with regional business needs.

Qualifications: 

  • 8+ years of experience in HR Shared Services / HR Operations with strong automation exposure .
